title: Robinhood Chain bug bounty (Cantina)
description: Live bug bounty on Cantina for Robinhood Chain (the chain the WARDEN token itself launches on). In scope here: the on-chain tokenization and just-in-time funding contracts, whose VERIFIED source was pulled from the Robinhood Chain Blockscout explorer (solc 0.8.33). AccessControlsRegistry (roles/permissions for the whole system), JustInTimeFunding (funds a spender just in time for a purchase, via signed authorizations). Rewards: Critical $1,000,000, High $100,000, Medium $25,000, Low $5,000. A fully working PoC is mandatory; all PoCs run locally in Foundry (no testing against mainnet or public testnet). Prefer deep, protocol-specific logic bugs: signature/replay/nonce handling in JustInTimeFunding, role escalation or missing checks in AccessControlsRegistry, authorization expiry, fund draining, cross-contract trust.
knownIssues: Anything requiring a privileged role (owner, admin, an account already granted a role in AccessControlsRegistry) to act maliciously is a trust assumption, not a finding. Arbitrum-authored bridge/rollup code is out of scope. Do not rely on faked state via vm.store/vm.etch/vm.mockCall. Gas, informational and best-practice notes are not accepted. The contracts are audited and deployed; only a genuinely new, exploitable bug pays.
